decisions.decision:
T-251 is done, so branch from current main and re-find each finding there (AUDIT.md line numbers are out of date). Also settle T-198's layout choice. Pick the learn.tsx variant that puts the why and how in the empty space beside the card at 1440px and stacks it above the controls at 390px. Make it the default with no query parameter, delete the other four, and record the pick on T-198.
Start-stack (N068): preselect the first option. Give each option one line on what it does and its real cost, taken from pricing already in the repo (Tantra $99/mo, etc.). Invent no figures and include no ruled-out tools.
Fields (N069, N070): add software, consultancy, course and solo examples to every typed field, d1_funnel_reason included.
Drafts (N080): no paid draft without consent. Ask once, store the answer per attendee, and auto-draft only after a yes.
Day 0 (N088): link the foundations chapters and open the funnel board full size.
Copy: Backlinko voice, Title Case. Run the centre probes, deploy, mark the six ids fixed in AUDIT.md with the commit, and close T-198.
